name: Parkomat International Ltd
summary: Parkomat International Ltd, headquartered in Ness Ziona, Israel, specializes in delivering end-to-end solutions for advanced mechanical and robotic parking systems, exclusively serving real estate developments across the nation. Since its inception in 2009, the firm manages all stages from conceptual design and development to production, installation, and ongoing maintenance of these sophisticated vehicle storage facilities. Its product range encompasses innovative parking optimization devices, such as space-multiplying mechanisms and various parking aids, alongside a complete portfolio of mechanical, semi-automatic, and fully automated robotic parking installations.
